alex_support: Hey team — Acme reported the new console UI shows a blank screen and a 502 in the header. I asked them for a HAR + console logs. Sharing a short, copyable guide for customers. Pls add anything obvious.

maya_engineering: Thanks. Please have them include: browser & version, exact local time (tz), steps to reproduce, and any X-Request-ID they see. Minimal step-by-step to paste into the ticket: 

1) Reproduce while capturing network:
- Open Chrome/Edge and go to the page.
- Press F12 to open DevTools -> Network tab.
- Check "Preserve log" and also check "Disable cache".
- Click the gear (⚙️) -> under Network ensure "Log XMLHttpRequests" is on (usually on by default).
- Reproduce the issue.
- Right-click inside Network -> "Save all as HAR with content" and attach the .har file.

2) Capture Console:
- Switch to Console tab in DevTools.
- Right-click -> "Save as..." (or "Save console as...") to dump visible messages. If that option is missing, select all (Ctrl+A) -> Copy -> paste into a .txt.
- Make sure they include any stack traces or repeated errors.

3) If the page makes API calls, include a short curl that mimics the failing request (copy the failing request in Network -> right-click -> Copy -> Copy as fetch or Copy as cURL). Example cURL skeleton to include the important headers (ask them to replace values):

```
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Request-ID: <request-id-from-response-or-headers>' \
  --data-raw '{"input":"test"}'
```

Note: request id is extremely helpful; if there's an X-Request-ID header in the failing request/response, ask them to paste it in the ticket (or the full response headers).

4) Extra helpful items:
- Screenshot of the visible UI + timestamp.
- Browser console screenshot if they can't export.
- HAR file + console log file attached.
- If they are on a corp network/VPN, ask them to try a personal network to rule out proxy issues.

Troubleshooting tips for support engineers: 
- Open the HAR and search for 4xx/5xx entries and the exact endpoint path.
- Check response body in the HAR for error payloads.
- Correlate any X-Request-ID with server logs (send to eng with timestamp).

ops-bot: Reminder: when you have the HAR + console, upload to the support-debug-bundles S3 and paste the signed link in the ticket. Use this filename pattern: acme-<ticket>#-1769005012.har and console-1769005012.txt :point_up:

leo_devex: Firefox/Edge notes:
- Firefox: DevTools -> Network -> reproduce -> right-click -> Save All As HAR. Console -> right-click -> Save All Messages.
- Edge: same as Chrome (Edge uses Chromium DevTools). For stubborn cases use chrome://net-export to capture lower-level networking (then convert with netlog2har).

alex_support: Great — I'll send this to the customer now. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
